items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: Kaifer and I played. That's another guy we used to play with, too, over here.

ctx.x: I thought Kid Kaifer was in there for a while.
I think Kaifer played there for a while, too. But I wasn't there. You weren't there, huh? No, I wasn't there when Kaifer played. Did you know Kaifer?
